text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp is drawing to a close, and the students are getting ready to head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Look, Trainer. Do you see the expressions on their faces?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Ryan! Once we get back, let's hit the track!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If you think I'm the same racer I was before camp, you've got another thing coming! You're going down!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You're the one who's going down! I've been itching to run since I got outta bed!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: How much stronger have I gotten?! How much better of a racer am I?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: My pecs are crying out… They've gotta know!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: They have a little more pep in their step, wouldn't you say? And it's all because they can feel how much they've improved.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Summer training has a way of bringing the best out of our students.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have no doubt they will all make marvelous debuts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And if my planning has contributed to their future success in some way, I will be more than satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Do you truly think I am so weak as to falter at this hurdle?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no trace of the loss of composure that I saw a few days ago.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You're staring, Trainer. Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Do you mean to ask if I feel I've improved over the course of the camp?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But of course. And now I'm ready to sally forth. My charge will be unstoppable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so this year's summer camp comes to an end.
